test_name: Mark-list marks placed by at, coloured signs and layered symbols (session 37)
description: The default 4-8 staff (4 semitones a staff space), cnb:keysig-style 'marks, no bars. m1 D major, columns 0.5 1.5 2.5: a default head on B (-1), below the staff, at (0.1 . 0), with its ledger; a test-dot head on D (14) at (-0.25 . -0.25) with a test-tail symbol layered on it at (0.25 . -0.05); a hollow test-dot symbol on F sharp (18) at (-0.25 . -0.25); a red sharp on C sharp (13), scale 1, at (-0.35 . 0.25). m2 B flat major, columns 0.5 1.5: a red flat on B flat (10), scale 0.6473, at (-0.3 . 0); a blue flat on E flat (15), scale 1, at (-0.46 . 0.25). Measured on 2.24 and 2.26 (the same on both): D major 3.169 wide and 5.826 tall, B flat major 1.641 wide and 3.761 tall. The same file with every at removed gives D major 3.069 x 5.75 (its left edge, the head's ledger, 0.1 further left; its top the hollow square's, centred on its column with its origin at F sharp) and B flat major 1.681 x 3.511. D major's left edge is the B head's ledger, which follows the head: the head's left (0.5 + 0.1 - 0.5) less a sixth of its width. Its right edge is the sharp's ink, which reaches 0.952 right of the sharp's origin (2.5 - 0.35); without at the sharp is centred, its origin at 2.5 - 0.55. Its top is the sharp's, raised 0.25 by its at, 1.576 above C sharp's height, and its bottom the B head's, half a staff space below B's height: the ledger, at the staff position of semitone 0, is above it. B flat major's top is the blue flat's, raised 0.25, 1.86 above E flat's height; its bottom the red flat's, 0.6473 of the flat's 0.62 below B flat's height. The semitones are found from the first notes: d'' (semitone 14) in m1 and b flat' (semitone 10) in m2, each centre half a staff space below its bbox top. The harvest records a signature's first colour: B flat major's is its first mark's, the red flat's (no bar or ledger is drawn before it).
